abstract_sentences.text: Aligning Large Language Models (LLMs) with human preferences is crucial for safe and effective AI interactions.

evidence.anchor: Aligning Large Language Models with human preferences

abstract_sentences.text: While popular methods like Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) have simplified alignment, they remain sensitive to data noise and overlook the differential importance of individual tokens.

evidence.anchor: remain sensitive to data noise and overlook the differential importance of individual tokens

abstract_sentences.text: Existing token-level approaches often rely on probability prediction or simplistic weighting schemes to obtain token importance, which still cannot fully address these issues.

evidence.anchor: probability prediction or simplistic weighting schemes to obtain token importance

abstract_sentences.text: To solve this problem, we propose the Token-Importance Guided Direct Preference Optimization (TI-DPO), a framework that achieves fine-grained semantic control through two synergistic innovations.

evidence.anchor: framework that achieves fine-grained semantic control through two synergistic innovations

abstract_sentences.text: First, we propose a novel hybrid weighting mechanism that combines gradient attribution with a Gaussian prior, ensuring both the accuracy and robustness of token importance scores.

evidence.anchor: combines gradient attribution with a Gaussian prior

abstract_sentences.text: Second, we employ a triplet loss to provide structured guidance for the optimization, explicitly guiding model outputs to approach preferred responses and diverge from non-preferred ones.

evidence.anchor: triplet loss to provide structured guidance

abstract_sentences.text: Experimental results show that TI-DPO achieves higher accuracy and stronger generative diversity, providing more stable and computationally efficient solutions compared with DPO and other RLHF methods.

evidence.anchor: higher accuracy and stronger generative diversity

abstract_sentences.text: Code and demo are available at https://github.com/gracefulning/TIDPO.

evidence.anchor: Code and demo are available at github.com/gracefulning/TIDPO

final_judgment.single_storyline: Sequence-level DPO 的粗粒度和噪声问题被重写为 token-level alignment：gradient attribution 找关键 token，Gaussian prior 稳定权重，triplet anchor 将输出拉向 preferred、推离 non-preferred；收益集中在 instruction/truthfulness/code，reasoning 和 training cost 是边界（pp.1–10, 22–23）。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留问题缺口、Eq.5–14、Algorithm 1、Lemma/Theorem statements、Table 1、Figure 1–4、Table 2 以及结论 headline/边界（pp.1–10）。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: Proofs Eq.18–40、cross-model tables、Pearson micro/macro、noise/diversity、convergence、sensitivity、hyperparameters、token tables、额外案例和 D.1–D.3 移到 pp.14–23；算法可读，但理论条件和复现实验粒度依赖附录。
final_judgment.best_pattern: Table 1 的跨任务锚点、Figure 1 的过程曲线、Table 2 的组件消融和 Figure 3/4 与 B2–B4 的 saliency 视觉共同覆盖效果、机制、组件必要性和解释直觉。
final_judgment.largest_gap: Theorem 2/3 依赖强 sparse-criticality/unbiasedness/curvature 假设；Theorem 2 未显式纳入 triplet 项；max-logit attribution 是 proxy；Eq.12/Algorithm/A.4 的 β 和 Eq.11/13 引用不一致；B12/B13 的 α 命名冲突；结果缺少 seed/uncertainty。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 把 token saliency 当作机制时，应配 matched counterfactual/intervention、negative control 和真实实验单位的重复结果；梯度图、平均分与条件 theorem 各承担有限证据范围。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 规则适用于局部 token importance 作为核心因果机制的 alignment/interpretability 论文；纯 sequence-level 方法应采用 sequence-level 干预。本文微观 Pearson=.18–.35 与 reasoning gap 说明 token weight 不能单独解释单题正确性或整体推理。
